units: metres, +X along the unmirrored vehicle, +Y down, origin at rail level
gear_ratio_definition: wheel angle = crank phase * gear_ratio, matching TECH_SPEC_RU section 5.4; same sign for this drive
calibration: Rocker pin radius comes from the supplied lever pivot/link pixels at a uniform 1.8 m beam width. This leaves clearance for the cargo through a full stroke. Crank centre matches the right wheel axle of the P2 body.
